title: On a bijection of Loehr and Remmel
summary: In this expository article we review a remarkable bijection $φ_n$ due to Loehr and Remmel from the set of parking functions of size n into itself, which sends the bistatistic (dinv, area) into the bistatistic (area, pmaj). The only novelty of the present work is our definition of $φ_n$, which is more direct than the original one, hence easier to compute and to work with.
